summary: Strawberry Fields REIT filed an 8-K reporting a Regulation S offering completed September 15, 2026, solely within Israel, of NIS 1,000 par Bonds (Series D) plus Warrants (Series 2) generating roughly $17 million gross proceeds. Warrants, exercisable on TASE listing and expiring December 30, 2027, each buy one common share at NIS 46 ($15.12 as of September 15), floored at the prior-day NYSE American close, covering 1,034,940 underlying shares registered on Form S-3. Mishmeret Trust Services serves as trustee under a September 14 deed of trust. This is a routine offshore debt-and-warrant financing, not a special situation; watch dilution from warrant exercises.
